description: Start recording the app and return at once, so you can drive it with another tool between this call and stop_recording: taps, swipes and flows from a simulator agent (Argent, agent-device, Maestro) or anything else. Records what record does (every shared value, both threads' frame rates and long frames, animations with call sites, React commits, JS tasks, UI-thread worklet time). One recording at a time; it stops by itself after 5 minutes. Use record instead for a fixed stretch while a person uses the app, and run_scenario when the app registered the interaction.

signals.description: Names or ids of shared values. Omit to record all of them, including ones that mount while recording.

name: start_recording
